extracted text: The paper describes a 2219 aluminum alloy with additions of Sc and Zr, designated as 2219ScZr. The alloy was processed through a novel three-stage heat treatment route: 1) Direct ageing of cast alloy at 375°C to form thermally stable L12 type coherent Al3(Sc, Zr) precipitates, 2) Solution treatment at 535°C for 30 min, and 3) Ageing at 200°C which caused formation of highly dense θ′′ (Al3Cu) and θ′ (Al2Cu) precipitates. Tensile properties were measured at room temperature, 200°C, and 250°C.
property mapping:
The paper provides the following properties:
- 0.2% PS (MPa) = Yield Strength (YS)
- UTS (MPa) = Ultimate Tensile Strength
- % El = Elongation percentage
- Vickers hardness (MPa) = Hardness
abbreviations:
2219ScZr = 2219 aluminum alloy with additions of Sc and Zr
PS = Proof Stress (equivalent to yield strength)
BAL = Balance (remainder of composition)
